selection_rule: Selected for illustration; the evaluation uses all days. From the evaluated real days: (1) the rule-selected default day (most observed dual-hazard hours), then (2) the top 6 by observed hours >=95F, (3) the top 6 by observed AQI>=101 hours, (4) 6 mild-stratum days by a fixed-seed draw (seed 20261024), (5) a fixed-seed draw from the rest to reach 24. Ties: earlier date, then id. Days already picked are skipped.
note: demo subset: 24 real days selected for illustration; the evaluation uses all days

summary_box: Days evaluated: 1309 (13 synthetic, 1296 real_cached); every day with enough history for the forecast proxy, none hand-picked.
The 13 synthetic days (7 of them generated history days) are illustrations: they show how the planner behaves, not that it reduces exposure in the field.
1296 region-days on 509 distinct dates in 3 regions. Region-days on the same date (and consecutive days) are correlated, so 1296 is not the effective sample size; CIs resample whole dates.
Heat-only planning is the closest baseline; see the B3 rows.
In the current synthetic data the optimizer never has fewer AQI>=101 hours than either B3 variant (0 of 13 days).
real_cached: the optimizer has fewer AQI>=101 hours than b3_early on 0 and than b3_late on 1 of 1296 days.
Numbers are modeled exposure-hours from station-level data. They are not health outcomes, not field microclimate, and not a compliance assessment.

definitions.primary_outcome: physical dominance: win = no more hours >=95F and no more AQI>=101 hours and strictly less on at least one; loss = the reverse; tie = all physical metrics within 0.125 h; otherwise mixed
definitions.secondary_outcome: uses the optimizer's own cost: win/loss by observed weighted cost; tie also needs cost within 1e-06; mixed = equal cost, different physical metrics
definitions.difference: challenger minus baseline; negative = fewer modeled exposure-hours or lower cost
definitions.robust: compared only on days where it did not fall back, and with the optimizer on those same days
definitions.ci: synthetic: paired bootstrap over days; real: cluster bootstrap over calendar dates
definitions.nowcast: SECONDARY, observed only: hours at NowCast AQI >= 101 / 151 (unverified NowCast); planning uses hourly values
definitions.weight_sensitivity: headline = day-level fraction of (setting, day) pairs; stratum totals secondary
